description: Permafrost active layer depth - Torngat Mountains is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Parks Canada | Parcs Canada. The Torngat National Park monitors the permafrost depth in the Ivitak wateshed. A temperature cable with 8 thermistors at depths from 0.5 to 7 m deep was installed in August 2010, and has been recording ground temperature at each depth at 8 hour intervals since that time. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Parks Canada | Parcs Canada. Its tags are Pergélisol, profondeur de la couche active, température du sol, Ivitak, Labrador. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2024-12-09 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
